name: sqt-trading-finance
description: Trading and personal finance toolkit for Thai investors — watchlists, signals, paper trading, trade journal, position sizing, dividends, budgets and scam checks, plus Thai money skills: investment tax, year-end deduction planning (/tax-plan), mutual funds, retirement, debt payoff and คลินิกแก้หนี้, insurance review and emergency funds.
